title: Collections Desk Reference: Missed Installments and Default of Payment Arrangements
content:
**Collections desk reference — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): missed installments and default**

**When an agreement defaults.** When the number of missed installments of the agreement reaches the tier's default count, the agreement defaults. The missed installments are counted over the life of the agreement, as the missed-installment entries on the agreement's ledger.

**Disconnection after a default.** Where the tier allows disconnection on the original notice and the account was under a disconnect notice when the agreement was accepted, the account may be disconnected on that notice without a new notice period; otherwise collection restarts under the Electric Service by Rate Schedule rules.

**After default.** A defaulted agreement is never reinstated, and it counts against later offers under the member's default history test.

**Retired clauses.** The two clauses below are no longer in force. The first is superseded by the current basis for a missed installment; the second by the current basis for the balance billed back at a default:

> ~~An installment counts as missed when the installment, together with the current charges of the same bill where the tier requires the current bill to be paid, is not paid in full within the tier's grace period of calendar days after that bill's due date.~~ — no longer in force.

> ~~The unbilled arranged balance is billed back at once as a default rebill and is due the tier's rebill due days after the default date.~~ — no longer in force.

**Desk table (hypothetical default counts)**

| Tier's default count | Missed-installment entries on the agreement | Agreement |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | runs on |
| 1 | 1 | defaults |
| 2 | 1 | runs on |
| 2 | 2 | defaults |

| Under a disconnect notice when accepted | Tier allows disconnection on the original notice | After the default |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | may be disconnected on that notice without a new notice period |
| yes | no | collection restarts under the Electric Service by Rate Schedule rules |
| no | yes | collection restarts under the Electric Service by Rate Schedule rules |
| no | no | collection restarts under the Electric Service by Rate Schedule rules |

superseded_clauses: An installment counts as missed when the installment, together with the current charges of the same bill where current_bill_must_be_paid is true, is not paid in full within missed_installment_grace_days calendar days after that bill's due date.
the unbilled arranged balance is billed back at once with rebill_reason default and is due default_rebill_due_days after the default date
